prompt: Your best friend's partner is cheating. Only you know.

options.text: Say nothing, but keep the proof somewhere safe, just in case
Stay out of it. It's their relationship
Tell your friend tonight, even though it’s their birthday party

prompt: Your sibling asks to borrow money. Again.

options.text: Lend it, with a written repayment plan
Tell them you're broke too
Lend it, then mention it in the family group chat

prompt: Your partner booked a surprise holiday. You hate the destination.

options.text: Go, and keep a list of everything wrong to bring up later
Smile and enjoy it for their sake
Pack for somewhere else entirely and see what happens

prompt: Your friend's cooking is terrible. They're hosting again.

options.text: Eat every bite. Guests don't criticise the host
Eat beforehand and slip your plate to their dog
Arrive early and "help" in the kitchen until it’s edible

prompt: Your parents want everyone at the family reunion. You would rather not.

options.text: Go, stay exactly two hours, leave on schedule
Go, and spend the day with the relative nobody talks to
Say yes, then come down with something mysterious on the day

prompt: Your ex asks you to be their plus-one at a wedding.

options.text: Go as a favour, with ground rules agreed in advance
Go for the free food and the open bar
Go, and bring a plus-one of your own

prompt: You find a wallet stuffed with cash and an ID.

options.text: Return it through the proper channels, then invoice them for your time
Leave it where it is. Not your problem
Track the owner down online and deliver it tonight

prompt: Your friend's startup is failing. They ask for your savings.

options.text: Invest a little, and help them write a proper business plan
Decline politely. Money ruins friendships
Decline, then pitch their idea to investors yourself

prompt: You're offered a promotion, but it means letting a teammate go.

options.text: Accept, and follow the process to the letter
Turn it down and stay with your team
Flip a coin in front of your boss

prompt: A cash machine gives you double what you asked for.

options.text: Report it to the bank, as you’re supposed to
Keep it. The bank will never notice
Spend it on pizza for the whole street

prompt: You win the lottery.

options.text: Tell no one, hire an adviser, change nothing
Quietly pay off your friends' debts
Buy the building your old boss works in, and raise the rent

prompt: A rich stranger offers you $10,000 to shave your head right now.

options.text: Accept, if it goes to a children’s hospital, with a receipt
Haggle them up to $20,000 first
Shave exactly half

prompt: A stranger's dog keeps following you home.

options.text: Report the owner to the council for letting it roam
Ignore it. It'll find its way
Follow the dog instead, to see where it lives

prompt: Someone is on a loud phone call in the quiet carriage.

options.text: Politely point at the 'Quiet' sign
Put your headphones in
Start narrating their call to the whole carriage

prompt: A street performer picks you as their volunteer.

options.text: Agree, if you get half the tips
Play along and make them look amazing
Play along, then take over the show

prompt: Your neighbour's hedge is 3 cm over your property line.

options.text: Measure it properly and send a formal letter
Say nothing, but block their drive now and then
Trim it at midnight into a lovely shape, as a gift

prompt: Everyone at the party is playing a game you find ridiculous.

options.text: Play by the rules anyway
Sit out, and keep the host company in the kitchen
Join in, and quietly rig it so you win

prompt: You get a button that silences every car alarm in the city.

options.text: Hand it to the council to use responsibly
Sell it to the highest bidder
Press it at 3 a.m. and see what happens

prompt: Zombie outbreak. You run the only safe bunker.

options.text: Let people in, in exchange for a lifetime of service
Seal the doors. Nobody in, nobody out
Leave the doors open and go looking for survivors

prompt: You become ruler of the country for one day.

options.text: Pass one sensible law everyone has been waiting for
Spend the day touring the palace
Settle every grudge you have ever had

prompt: Your lifeboat holds five. There are six of you.

options.text: Draw straws, and make sure the loser respects the result
Take turns swimming alongside
Row back to the ship for another boat

prompt: You can read minds for one day.

options.text: Only read people who say it’s okay
Win every argument and every bet
Walk around town fixing people's problems before they ask

prompt: A supervillain offers you a job. Great benefits.

options.text: Accept, and just do the job you were hired for
Decline, and warn the other recruits
Accept, then plot to take over their empire

prompt: You discover a portal to another world in your basement.

options.text: Report it, and help scientists study it safely
Charge the neighbours for a peek
Walk through it in your pajamas
